sn22.97:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu, bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.97:1.3: “atthi nu kho bhante, kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati?
sn22.97:1.4: atthi nu kho bhante, kāci vedanā …pe… kāci saññā …pe…
sn22.97:1.7: atthi nu kho bhante, kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti?
sn22.97:1.8: natthi kho bhikkhu, kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:1.9: natthi kho bhikkhu, kāci vedanā …pe… natthi kho bhikkhu,
sn22.97:1.12: kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
sn22.97:2.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn22.97:2.2: “ettakampi kho bhikkhu, rūpaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:2.3: ettakampi ce bhikkhu, rūpaṃ abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:2.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu, ettakampi rūpaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya,
sn22.97:3.1: ettakāpi kho bhikkhu, vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:3.2: ettakāpi ce bhikkhu, vedanā abhavissa niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:3.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu, ettikāpi vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:4.2: ettakā pi kho bhikkhu, saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti,
sn22.97:4.3: ettakāpi bhikkhu, saṅkhārā abhavissaṃsu niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:4.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakāpi saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:5.1: ettakampi kho bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:5.2: ettakampi ce bhikkhu, viññāṇaṃ abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:5.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu, ettakampi viññāṇaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
